title: CRASH THE SERVERS.... and unlock 40,000 additional accounts!

posts.h:
Still waiting patiently to play Brick-Force? Almost 350,000 players have already registered for closed beta. Very soon the servers will be opened giving you all chance to give the game a spin for perhaps the very first time.

Your support during the stress tests will help us experiment with our hardware, helping us to launch a smooth and successful beta later this spring. Be prepared for possible lag and crashes!

We just announced on our Facebook page that if the Brick-Force community manages to crash the servers, we will activate a whooping 40,000 Brick-Force accounts. But that’s not all! For every comment left on our Facebook post, we’ll unlock another 10 accounts. No joke!


For more information, please check out the Stress Test FAQ,also available in the following languages:

title: Server Maintenance & First Stress Test Completed

posts.h:
The first phase of our stress testing has now come to a close and there will be a global server shutdown at 16:00 CET / 11:00 EDT today.

Today a further 40,000 accounts will be unlocked from those who were active in the stress test.


  • European servers should be back online between 21:00 and 22:00 CET.

We believe that overall, our stress test was a success. Some critical information has been gathered and we've gathered some interesting data, thanks to your help.

We now have a stronger idea of the best way to tackle some lag issues and improve our network performance.

We are now hard at work on a new update which will enable us to reduce the latency that some players are experiencing. It is currently our top priority to get this performance patch pushed out as soon as possible.

Thanks to everyone who participated in the stress test. We look forward to seeing you online again for the second test, taking place next Tuesday, the 27th March!
